question.text: Which THREE benchmarking agencies have been appointed by the Indian Private Equity and Venture Capital Association (IVCA) to publish AIF benchmarks in INR and USD terms, per Section 10.8.1 of the Chapter?

answer.text: Fitch, S&P Dow Jones Indices, and FTSE Russell.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 10.8.1 explicitly: 'Currently, there are three benchmarking agencies appointed by IVCA... These benchmarks published by CRISIL, NSE and Preqin cover performance data of the AIFs.' Cambridge Associates and PitchBook are GLOBAL databases but are not IVCA-notified Indian agencies. **The Trap:** Option B mixes up global players with the Indian notified list. Option C names credit-rating agencies (ICRA, CARE) — relevant for bond indices, not AIF benchmarking. Option D names international index providers. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A/B test the existence of IVCA benchmarks. XIX-C tests the exact three notified agencies. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Register with AT LEAST two of the three (CRISIL + NSE is a common combo). Some LPs have internal preferences; offering both benchmark reports in your data room accelerates diligence by 2-4 weeks versus forcing the LP to reconcile a single source.
